stem.text: A box containing two electrical components is connected into a circuit.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with components labelled V, box, A and a variable resistor, and a battery at the top.

stem.text: The variable resistor is adjusted and measurements are taken to determine the $I$–$V$ characteristic for the box, as shown.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis I and horizontal axis V, origin 0. A curve is drawn in the upper-right quadrant rising from the origin, and a short line is drawn to the left of the origin.

stem.text: Which arrangement of two electrical components in the box would create the best fit to the measured $I$–$V$ characteristic?

A.text: a filament lamp and a fixed resistor in parallel

B.text: a filament lamp and a fixed resistor in series

C.text: a semiconductor diode and a filament lamp in parallel

D.text: a semiconductor diode and a filament lamp in series
